fields.label: Missed Check-in Threshold (minutes)
fields.description: How long a guard's Active shift can go with no GPS ping before it's flagged as a missed check-in.

fields.label: SOS Escalation Threshold (minutes)
fields.description: Total silence beyond this auto-opens a tracked SOS Incident Report, on top of the regular missed check-in alert. Should be longer than the threshold above.

fields.label: Notification Rules
fields.description: Per-role control over which alert types each role hears about, plus a (not yet wired) report subscription. Leave this table empty and every alert type falls back to Security Head + System Manager (Receiving Alerts falls back to the Stock User role) - exactly as before this became configurable. Add rows to take explicit control: once at least one row exists, only the checked alert types for each role fire - leaving every checkbox off for an alert type across all rows deliberately silences it for everyone, it does not fall back to the default.

fields.label: Gates
fields.description: Security's own list of physical gates per farm (a farm can have a Main Gate plus others) - lives entirely here, the Farm doctype itself is never touched.

fields.label: Dispatch Sources
fields.description: Which doctype(s) count as a dispatch document the gate can look up and verify against. Add a row here to support another dispatch doctype without any code change.
